protocol:
Activation and Intracellular Staining of Whole Blood: For the Detection of Intracellular Cytokines and Other Intracellular Targets
Dilute heparinized whole blood 1:1 with sterile appropriate tissue culture medium.
At this stage, in vitro cellular stimulation by either antigen or mitogen can be performed.
If intending to stain intracellular cytokines or chemokines (e.g.
IFN-γ or IL-4), addition of an efficient protein transport inhibitor such as brefeldin A (BioLegend Cat.
No.
420601) or monensin (BioLegend Cat.
No.
420701) is critical.
After addition of a suitable cellular activator, aliquot 200 μl of the whole blood cell suspension into 12 x 75 mm plastic tubes and incubate for 4-6 hours in 5% CO2 at 37°C.
Add 2 ml of 1X Red Blood Cell Lysis Buffer (Cat.
No.
420301) and incubate for 5-10 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 350 x g for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Wash cells 1X with Cell Staining Buffer.
If staining intracellular antigens (e.g.
IFN-γ or IL-4), first perform cell surface antigen staining as described in BioLegend’s Cell Surface Immunofluorescence Staining Protocol, then fix cells in 0.5 ml/tube Fixation Buffer (BioLegend Cat.
No.
420801) in the dark for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 350 x g for 5 minutes, discard supernatant.
To put the experiment “on hold” at this point for future staining and analysis, wash cells 1x with Cell StainingBuffer (BioLegend Cat.
No.
420201).
Resuspend cells in Cell Staining Buffer and store cells at 4°C (short term) or in 90% FCS/10% DMSO for storage at -80°C (long term, for fixed cells without surface antigen staining).
Dilute 10X Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer (Cat.
No.
421002) to 1X in DI water.
Resuspend fixed cells in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer and centrifuge at 350 x g for 5-10 minutes.
(1/3).
Resuspend fixed cells in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer and centrifuge at 350 x g for 5-10 minutes.
(2/3).
Resuspend fixed cells in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer and centrifuge at 350 x g for 5-10 minutes.
(3/3).
Resuspend fixed/permeabilized cells in residual Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer and add a predetermined optimum concentration of fluorophore-conjugated antibody of interest (e.g.
PE anti-IFN-γ) or an appropriate negative control for 20 minutes in the dark at room temperature.
Wash with 2 ml of Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer andcentrifuge at 350 x g for 5 minutes.
(1/2).
Wash with 2 ml of Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer andcentrifuge at 350 x g for 5 minutes.
(2/2).
If primary intracellular antibody is biotinylated, it will be necessary to perform fluorophore conjugatedStreptavidin incubations and subsequent washes in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer.
Resuspend fixed and intracellularly labeled cells in 0.5 ml Cell Staining Buffer and analyze with appropriate controls.
Set PMT voltage and compensation using cell surface staining controls.
Set quadrant markers based on blocking controls, isotype controls, or unstained cells.

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
dilute(reagent='heparinized whole blood, sterile tissue culture medium', volume='1:1 ratio')
add(reagent='protein transport inhibitor (brefeldin A or monensin)', when='if staining intracellular cytokines or chemokines')
aliquot(container='12 x 75 mm plastic tubes', reagent='whole blood cell suspension', volume='200 μl')
incubate(container='12 x 75 mm plastic tubes', reagent='whole blood cell suspension (with activator/inhibitor)', volume='200 μl', temperature='37°C, 5% CO2', duration='4-6 hours')
add(container='12 x 75 mm plastic tubes', reagent='1X Red Blood Cell Lysis Buffer', volume='2 ml')
incubate(container='12 x 75 mm plastic tubes', reagent='whole blood cell suspension with lysis buffer', temperature='room temperature', duration='5-10 minutes')
centrifuge(container='12 x 75 mm plastic tubes', reagent='cell suspension', duration='5 minutes', speed='350 x g')
discard(container='12 x 75 mm plastic tubes', reagent='supernatant')
wash(container='12 x 75 mm plastic tubes', reagent='Cell Staining Buffer', volume='1X')
fix(container='tube', reagent='Fixation Buffer', volume='0.5 ml/tube', temperature='room temperature', duration='20 minutes', in the dark=True)
centrifuge(container='tube', reagent='fixed cells', duration='5 minutes', speed='350 x g')
discard(container='tube', reagent='supernatant')
wash(container='tube', reagent='Cell Staining Buffer', volume='1X')
resuspend(container='tube', reagent='Cell Staining Buffer')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: store (container: tube, reagent: cells in Cell Staining Buffer, temperature: 4°C (short term) or -80°C (long term, in 90% FCS/10% DMSO), other: {'for fixed cells without surface antigen staining': True})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
dilute(reagent='10X Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', volume='to 1X in DI water')
resuspend(container='tube', reagent='Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', fixed cells=True)
centrifuge(container='tube', reagent='fixed cells in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', duration='5-10 minutes', speed='350 x g')
resuspend(container='tube', reagent='Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', fixed cells=True)
centrifuge(container='tube', reagent='fixed cells in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', duration='5-10 minutes', speed='350 x g')
resuspend(container='tube', reagent='Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', fixed cells=True)
centrifuge(container='tube', reagent='fixed cells in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', duration='5-10 minutes', speed='350 x g')
resuspend(container='tube', reagent='residual Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', fixed/permeabilized cells=True)
add(container='tube', reagent='fluorophore-conjugated antibody or negative control', volume='predetermined optimum concentration', temperature='room temperature', duration='20 minutes', in the dark=True)
wash(container='tube', reagent='Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', volume='2 ml')
centrifuge(container='tube', reagent='cells in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', duration='5 minutes', speed='350 x g')
wash(container='tube', reagent='Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', volume='2 ml')
centrifuge(container='tube', reagent='cells in Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', duration='5 minutes', speed='350 x g')
incubate(container='tube', reagent='fluorophore-conjugated Streptavidin (if required)', if primary antibody is biotinylated=True)
wash(container='tube', reagent='Intracellular Staining Perm Wash Buffer', after Streptavidin incubation=True)
resuspend(container='tube', reagent='Cell Staining Buffer', volume='0.5 ml', fixed and intracellularly labeled cells=True)
